output.summary: A small to medium flowering tree native to Tasmanian woodlands, cider gum has mostly smooth bark, bluish-green leaves and white flowers in groups of three. Tasmanian Aboriginal people used its sap to make a fermented beverage called way-a-linah.
output.edibilityNote: Tasmanian Aboriginal people used the tree's sap to produce the fermented beverage way-a-linah.
